# Screenshot corpus

This directory contains real, unmodified source images for evaluating Skills-panel
resource readers. `manifest.json` is generated by `build_manifest.py` and records
source URLs, SHA-256 digests, dimensions, client evidence, train/heldout splits,
and visually verified values and boxes. No synthetic image is included.

The corpus contains **19 preserved source images**:

| Role | Images | Use |
|---|---:|---|
| Positive acceptance | 7 | Target or visually equivalent full-client resource layouts |
| Negative safety control | 1 | Full window with Skills closed |
| Ambiguity safety control | 1 | Full window with both Skills and Character resource panels |
| Reference diagnostics | 10 | Nine source crops and one visibly different older full client |

Only `user-paulistinha-20261013` is confirmed as the supplied target capture.
[`visual-review.json`](visual-review.json) records the defining visual checks
for every source. A matching resource interface is treated as interchangeable
for these four fields when no relevant incompatibility is visible. This is not
an assertion of an exact shared executable build.

Full positive image dimensions range from 1360×705 to 1920×1080 and include
left/right docking, lower panels, different window proportions, macOS chrome,
and an open Market dialog. These are the downloaded image dimensions, not
claims about supported native game resolutions or Windows DPI. Source bytes,
player names and existing publisher marks are preserved. No local resize,
crop, relocation or occlusion is used in acceptance.

## Box and label contract

- `box_format` is `xyxy-half-open`: `[left, top, right, bottom]` in absolute source-image pixels.
- A resource `box` tightly encloses the numeric glyphs, including a displayed thousands separator.
- `skills_panel.box` encloses the visible panel. It is `null` when the panel is closed.
- `manual_verified` means the value and bounds were visually checked against the preserved source image.
- `not_visible` means that Skills-row label/value is absent, so `value` and `box` are `null`.
- `classification` describes corpus similarity (`confirmed`, `similar`, or `negative`).
- `expected_discovery` records whether a unique automatic panel binding is expected.
- Ambiguity controls retain visible numeric truth but require no layout and all four final readings unknown.
- `render_equivalence` records the reviewed status, evidence and scope of visual interchangeability.
- `coverage` distinguishes full screenshots from supplemental crops.
- `asset_fidelity` distinguishes source-original downloads from a source site's transcode.

The Kalibra 1016×706 and PVP 970×637 sources are supplemental crops: client
edges are truncated or uncertain. Earlier reports incorrectly counted them as
full screenshots; the current manifest and scorecards correct that classification.
The seven Portal Tibia sources are also crops. The Tibia Beta full-window source
is a visibly different reference because its compass/tools, font and panel
context differ from the target.

The original fourteen sources have already been examined during development.
Their historical train/heldout labels are preserved for reproducibility; they
are known regression cases. Five new sources were selected and annotated before
reader inference on 2026-10-14: Gentebra, Lutabra, Calmera, the natural two-panel
control, and the older Beta reference. The first full evaluation is archived in
[`iteration-03-real-originals.json`](../../../reports/iterations/iteration-03-real-originals.json).
Calmera and Beta then moved to train when their misses were examined. Subsequent
failure-driven tuning must likewise be recorded and moves affected sources to train. A single evaluation on these
few public screenshots does not establish general gameplay reliability.

## Client-version evidence

The supplied title bar says `Paulistinha Ot - Matusalah`; it does not show a
version string. Separate analysis of the supplied executable identified it as a
modified CipSoft 15.30 Qt6 client signed by LORD PAULISTINHA GAMES LTDA. That is
strong evidence for the installed binary context, but it does not prove that the
preserved screenshot came from that exact file or build. A third-party compatibility
page also distinguishes Paulistinha's CipSoft 15.30 and PTC clients:
<https://drenoxbot.com/paulistinha>. Accordingly, the target screenshot entry keeps
`client.version` as `null` instead of inferring `15.30` from appearance or date.

The seven Portal Tibia images come from a page posted on January 11, 2016:
<https://forum.portaltibia.com.br/topic/32425-chars-skills/>. They predate the
Qt-era client and are explicitly supplemental legacy cases. A post date is not an
installed-version identifier.

The full-window negative comes from a 2024 screenshot guide on a supported Tibia
fansite: <https://tibiadecorations.com/quality-screenshots/>. Its page describes
the image as a full Tibia client window, but does not state a build. The DFG
sources were downloaded from image URLs exposed by Tibia account listings at
<https://www.dfg.com.br/pt/tibia/contas>; those listing titles and visible layouts
support the family classification, not an exact version.

## Rebuild and audit

Run:

```bash
python tests/fixtures/screenshots/build_manifest.py
```

The generator fails if a referenced image is missing and recalculates integrity
metadata from the preserved bytes. Full live-client compatibility still requires
testing against the intended Paulistinha installation; offline screenshots cannot
prove capture behavior, UI scaling, or live input support.

## Add evidence and compare a change

1. Preserve the complete source image in `originals/` and record its page/image
   URLs, capture context, and available version evidence in `build_manifest.py`
   or `additional-sources.json`; record the independent visual review in
   `visual-review.json`.
   Keep source crops explicitly classified as supplemental crops.
2. Visually annotate the displayed values and tight glyph boxes. Mark hidden
   fields as not visible. Do not change annotations to fit a detector's output.
3. Assign the split by source before evaluation; generated variants inherit it.
   A source used to choose assets or tune a rule becomes train data. Use a new,
   untouched source for a fresh heldout check.
4. Rebuild the manifest and run the corpus tests. They reject missing files and
   images in `originals/` that are absent from the manifest, so new captures
   cannot silently escape the benchmark.
5. Archive the current comparison, make the reader change, then run the full
   [comparison and runtime commands](../../../docs/resource-benchmark.md).
   Compare incorrect accepted values, unknowns, association failures, and
   latency separately. A lower error count obtained by returning more unknowns
   is an explicit coverage trade-off, not evidence of universally better reading.
